name: 1.23.0-beta.41
notes: Ren'Py games: Modding mode. In a game, the new flowchart button (next to the pencil) opens the game's story as a flowchart: one box per scene with its lines, and arrows for every jump and call. Tap a line to change what is said and who says it, tap a jump to make it go to another scene, tap a choice to rename it, hide it or make it lead somewhere else, add a choice to a menu, or make a whole new scene. Drag to move around, pinch or scroll to zoom, and search for a scene or a line. The changes are kept in a “Story edits” mod (switch it off on the game's page to play the game as it was) and work in the running game at once.
